stories.title: Trump’s billionaire-blue collar coalition has been smashed by class politics | Aditya Chakrabortty
stories.summary: A Guardian opinion column argues that class politics has fractured Donald Trump’s coalition of billionaires and blue-collar voters. It says technology executives have grown richer while ordinary Americans struggle, and that voters responded to Democrats’ case against economic inequality.

links.headline: Trump’s billionaire-blue collar coalition has been smashed by class politics
links.excerpt: As tech bosses get richer and ordinary Americans struggle, Democrats put the case against the US’s grotesque unfairness – and voters responded Remember the “vibe shift”?
